design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values handling is not applicable because the study estimates latent proficiency directly via an IRT-style graded response model.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study uses PISA data but does not mention applying any sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not provide evidence of using multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering in its analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.

design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): Across 31 participating countries/economies… estimating latent proficiency using three hierarchical measurement models… EAP reliability increased from 0.73 (M1) to 0.77 (M2) and 0.80 (M3)… Country-level mean proficiency estimates were largely stable across models.
design_fields._q2_audit: Corrected not_met to not_reported because original rationale reports absence of weight information or an inference, not direct evidence of unweighted analysis; source verification still required.
